name: on-dig-net-urn-conformance
description: Holds both of on.dig.net's standalone DIG URN parsers — assets/dig-embed.js parseDigRef and assets/sw.js parseDigUrn — to the ratified cross-repo parse contract, read from the INSTALLED @dignetwork/dig-sdk package (conformance/urn-parse.json). Lives in its own package because the repo root is a Rust crate with no package.json, and the table must come from a real dependency rather than a copy.
